title: CUMA: Aligning LLMs with Sparse Cultural Values via Demographic-Aware Mixture of Adapters
reasoning: The paper focuses on aligning LLMs with diverse human and cultural values, specifically addressing the suppression of minority perspectives. It evaluates its framework using the WorldValuesBench (derived from the World Values Survey), which measures traditional vs. secular/individualist values and includes religion as a key demographic attribute for routing and evaluation (e.g., identifying an 'African-Islamic bloc').
